Optimal Sequential Search

You visit shops one by one, hunting for the best price. Each extra shop costs you money. So you set one cutoff value in advance. An offer better than the cutoff, you buy at once. An offer worse than the cutoff, you keep looking. That cutoff is the reservation value in the formula below. For example, you shop around for a 👕 shirt. Each extra shop costs 1,000 won in 🚌 bus fare. You decide in advance: under 50,000 won, I buy immediately. At 60,000 won you walk out. At 48,000 won you buy on the spot.
